messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments.

LU-19932 is still open (marked a duplicate of LU-19536, which is In Progress), and the failure mode recorded in the ticket is an uninterruptible sleep in osc_extent_wait() reached via ll_writepages()->cl_sync_file_range()->osc_cache_wait_range(). On a client that still has the bug, test_119s does not simply fail: python3 parks in D state, the subtest never returns, umount at cleanup blocks behind it, and the rest of the sanity run on that node is lost until it is rebooted. That is a different cost from a normal test failure.

Would it be better to hold this until the fix lands, or to land it now with 119s listed in ALWAYS_EXCEPT referencing LU-19932, so it can be run deliberately against a candidate fix without wedging every review run?

Patch Set 1: Code-Review-1

This change cannot be cherry-picked to master.
Please rebase the change locally and upload the rebased commit for review.
